title: Operation Undo Stack
description: Process a sequence of integer operations on a stack. PUSH x adds x, POP removes the top value, and TOP reports the current top. Every POP and TOP operation in the input is guaranteed to be valid.
inputFormat: First line: q. Each following line is either PUSH x, POP, or TOP.
outputFormat: For every TOP operation, print the current top value on its own line. Print nothing for PUSH and POP.

examples.input:
7
PUSH 10
PUSH 20
TOP
POP
TOP
PUSH 30
TOP
examples.explanation: TOP observes the most recently pushed value that has not been removed.
After removing 3, the top value is 7.
